top_comments.author: @Teslaspecter
top_comments.text: I have been really disappointed in claude lately. it argues and stops working on the first sign of opposition. it never takes that  next step to figure things out, and as the "leading frontier ai model" I feel like I should not have to say "try harder" every time i prompt; I do not have to do that for copilot, gpt, grok or composer. How do you get claude to create one of anything, website or other code without it forgetting truly basic fundamental things?
